headline: Learning summary for 2026-10-01: no new moneyline picks graded today. Leo's current record: 378-241 (61.1%) across 619 graded games (all statuses, model leo).

gates.note: Official picks require high model probability and strong setup quality. A high Lab Rating alone is not enough. (Market edge is no longer a gate -- a picked side with a lower market-implied probability than the model's read can still qualify, as long as market data exists for the game at all.)

findings.title: No new moneyline picks graded today
findings.read: No moneyline picks finished grading for this date. The findings below draw on the full graded history instead.

findings.title: Probability gate
findings.read: No high-Lab, low-probability moneyline setups appeared in the graded official set.

findings.title: What's working: Lab Rating components
findings.read: Over 618 graded picks with a reconciling breakdown, pitching plan is the strongest working piece of Lab Rating right now -- picks scoring above its median win 64.6% of the time vs. 57.7% below (lift +6.9%, correlation to winning +0.105).

findings.title: What's not working: Lab Rating components
findings.read: bullpen -- correlation to winning -0.069, lift -3.8% over 618 picks. Currently not earning its points -- moves the score without moving the record. Bullpen no longer scores Lab Rating (removed 2026-08-30, folded into pitching plan) -- this is its pre-change record, not a live component.

findings.title: Bullpen learning
findings.read: Across all reviewed days, 23 graded moneyline picks carried a meaningful bullpen caution. Bullpen was removed from Lab Rating's own scoring on 2026-08-30 (folded into pitching plan) -- this caution count is a separate, still-live read from the bullpen-fatigue system, unaffected by that change. For reference, its PRE-CHANGE scoring history correlated -0.069 with winning over 618 picks (lift -3.8%). Currently not earning its points -- moves the score without moving the record.

findings.title: Pitcher learning
findings.read: No major starting-pitcher conflicts showed up in the graded moneyline set. Statistically, the pitching-plan component correlates +0.105 with winning over 618 picks (lift +6.9%).

shadow_model.note: Only rows from the latest matching official/shadow model-version pair are compared. Promote nothing from a mixed-version sample.

attribution.note: Win rate by input tertile, pick-side relative. |spread| = high-band win rate minus low-band — bigger magnitude = the metric separates winners from losers harder, and deserves weight. Read direction too: a NEGATIVE spread on a should-be-positive factor is a red flag.

kprops.note: Bias = actual minus projection (positive means we under-project). Leans only counted at 0.7+ strikeout edges. Small samples early — a lean record means little before ~100 graded pitchers.

calibration.note: Shadow ledger for learning only — never part of the public record. Official picks stay the only published record.

recommendations: Full-history record across every analyzed game (all tiers, all dates): 462-301 (60.6%), n=763. This is what the correlations below are measured against -- not just the 22 current-model official picks.
Lab Rating's pitching-plan component score: r=0.073 (n=763) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.00 to 10.00): 110-80 (57.9%). Top quarter (27.00 to 40.00): 124-69 (64.2%).
Lab Rating's pitcher-edge component score: r=0.072 (n=763) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.00 to 8.00): 110-80 (57.9%). Top quarter (27.00 to 40.00): 124-69 (64.2%).
Leo's own win probability for this pick: r=0.070 (n=763) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.44 to 0.56): 98-92 (51.6%). Top quarter (0.72 to 0.74): 118-75 (61.1%).

Model edge over the market (model prob minus no-vig market prob): r=-0.066 (n=752) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (-0.32 to 0.02): 107-81 (56.9%). Top quarter (0.17 to 0.50): 98-90 (52.1%).

Team strength blend edge, before any pitcher/bullpen adjustment (picked side minus opponent): r=0.066 (n=618) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (-0.25 to -0.04): 92-62 (59.7%). Top quarter (0.10 to 0.30): 99-57 (63.5%).

Lab Rating's bullpen component score (retired 2026-08-30 -- pre-change history only): r=-0.063 (n=763) -- little to no relationship. Bottom quarter (0.00 to 0.00): 117-73 (61.6%). Top quarter (9.41 to 20.00): 116-77 (60.1%).
Pick tier (official / value watch / watchlist / pass): value_watch 18-8 (69.2%, n=26) vs. watchlist 77-45 (63.1%, n=122) vs. official_pick 45-29 (60.8%, n=74) vs. pass 322-219 (59.5%, n=541).
Picked the home team vs. the road team: Home 259-146 (64.0%, n=405) vs. Road 203-155 (56.7%, n=358).
These are correlations across Leo's own analyzed history, not causal proof and not a signal to change any model weight or gate on their own -- human review still required for any actual change.
